text:
erin-cs: Heads-up — AcmePay escalation. They say the model is now confidently inventing company timelines and acquisition details that are plain wrong. Started after our 2.5 canary this morning.
customer-acmepay: Example from support convo:
User: 'When was AcmePay founded and who were the early investors?'
Model: 'AcmePay was founded in 2010 by Marco Li and received seed from BlueRiver Capital in 2011.'
Customer: 'Both of those are incorrect (we launched 2014, no BlueRiver).'

erin-cs: They attached three more examples — wrong founding years, invented acquisitions, and a fabricated CTO name. They say it used to be accurate before 2.5. They want this prioritized, escalated to eng/ML.

alex-eng: Thanks Erin. Can you paste the exact prompts + full raw responses? Also which model id + variant did the requests hit?

maya-support: Pasting one raw request below (redacted api key):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
{
  "model": "redwood-neo-2.5-canary",
  "input": "When was AcmePay founded and who were early investors?",
  "max_tokens": 120
}
```
Raw response: "AcmePay was founded in 2010 by Marco Li. Early investors included BlueRiver Capital and Ember Ventures."

maya-support: Customer confirms correct public facts: founded 2014, founders are Ana Gomez + Lee Park, no BlueRiver in cap table.

sam-ml: Interesting. Did the canary include any new knowledge distillation or prompt-template changes? Also any routing changes to use a different knowledge-augmented variant?

deploy-bot: Deployment note: 2.5 canary rolled out to 10% at 1976543000 by rollout-service. No knowledge distillation scheduled. Variant routing rule 'prefer-latency' enabled at 1976542800 for canary traffic.

alex-eng: OK. Possible leads: (1) model-textual-rewrites that make up specific dates/names when confidence thresholds changed, (2) routing to a trimmed knowledge-conditioned variant without wiki context, (3) deterministic output bias due to new tokenization tweak. We need repro.
erin-cs: Customer provided a minimal repro flow: call above prompt 5x, gets invented dates consistently. They can share a full transcript and request IDs (will upload).

linda-sre: Can someone grab request ids+logs? If routing forced canary to a model without our external knowledge cache, that'll explain it. Also check prefix cache differences.

maya-support: Uploaded transcript and three request IDs: r-1976543101, r-1976543112, r-1976543130. Also included the full chat snippets.

alex-eng: Taking the logs. Quick check: these request IDs hit model redwood-neo-2.5-canary at zone us-west-2-a. Latency normal ~120ms. No errors.

sam-ml: I pulled the model variant config for that canary: quantization profile Q4f applied, and knowledge-caching was disabled temporarily for this rollout (bug in rollout script). That would remove our external wiki/context retrieval layer. That could increase confident confabulation.
erin-cs: Can we confirm expected behavior when knowledge-cache is disabled? Should default to saying 'I don't know' or be more hedged? Customer reports assertive answers instead.

sam-ml: Base LM will still try to answer from parametric memory — often it hallucinates specifics. Our knowledge-cache previously injected citations and hedging. With it off, assertive falsehoods are plausible.

alex-eng: Plan: (A) temporarily route AcmePay traffic to stable 2.4 until we fix cache toggles, (B) roll back canary knowledge-cache config, (C) add quick eval: run the customer prompts against 2.4 and 2.5 with/without cache to capture diff.

maya-support: Customer okay with temporary rollback. They want confirmation when done and a short RCA.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: routing rule updated at 1976543230 to send customer-acmepay to redwood-neo-2.4-stable. Will monitor.

linda-sre: I'll watch for errors and ensure no broader traffic disruption.

sam-ml: I'm running the differential eval now. Quick snippet of repro command I'm using:
```
for model in redwood-neo-2.4-stable redwood-neo-2.5-canary:
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"'$model'","input":"When was AcmePay founded and who were early investors?","max_tokens":120}' | jq .text
```

sam-ml: Early results (raw):
- 2.4-stable + cache: "AcmePay was founded in 2014 by Ana Gomez and Lee Park. Early investors included..." (hedged + correct)
- 2.5-canary without cache: "AcmePay was founded in 2010 by Marco Li. Early investors included BlueRiver Capital." (confident + incorrect)

alex-eng: This matches customer report. Root cause likely rollout script that disabled knowledge-cache for the canary. Follow-up action items: fix rollout script (eng-infra), add automated smoke eval that runs fact-check prompts post-rollout (ml/reliability), and notify customers with timeline and mitigation.
erin-cs: I'll send AcmePay an update: explanation + apology + timeline + temporary routing to 2.4. Also offer them a shared diff of the transcripts and a credit for the disruption.

maya-support: Leaving a note in the ticket: "We've rerouted you to a stable variant while we fix the canary config. Expect follow-up within 24h with RCA." :white_check_mark:

customer-acmepay: Thanks for the quick action. Please keep us posted — this was blocking an internal demo.

sam-ml: Will follow up with a short write-up and propose a new pre-rollout checklist item: verify knowledge-cache enabled and run a small factuality eval against a standard prompt set.

alex-eng: Assigning tasks: infra to patch rollout script (@linda-sre assist), ml to add smoke eval, cs to communicate and manage customer. Thanks team.

erin-cs: I'll update ticket and close this Slack thread for now. If anyone finds more anomalies, ping here. :pray:
